dogecoin.text: @MattWallace888 @IOHK_Charles @mcuban Dogecoin inflates just like fiat currencies do, what is the utility in switching from government money to magic dogecoin money?

@vishwajeetrata5 They're both similar in terms of network validation and governance models. Major difference is that BTC supply is capped whilst Dogecoin is inflationary. 1 Doge today is worth less than 1 Doge tomorrow if we measure it in terms of dogecoins.
